import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.313208411451037
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t); c2 = np.cos(2*w*t); s2 = np.sin(2*w*t)
    base = params[0] + params[1]*v + params[2]*v*v + params[3]*v**3
    h1 = params[4]*c + params[5]*s + params[6]*v*c + params[7]*v*s + params[8]*v*v*c + params[9]*v*v*s
    h2 = -0.197*c2 + 0.0755*s2 - 0.185*v*c2 + 0.681*v*s2
    return base + h1 + h2
